source_items.name: Anticipation / available
source_items.review: The open palms, warm face and complete fin establish a connected care body. Loaded but not sampled by the current receiving controller.

source_items.name: Receive
source_items.review: Cupped palms, sleeves, elbows and torso belong to one complete silhouette; the source contains no baked baby. Actual catch requires the visible palms to arrive.

source_items.name: Lift
source_items.review: Hands rise close to the face while the apron and rainbow hair remain recognizable. The same separate baby stays on the measured palm socket.

source_items.name: Hold / carry
source_items.review: Support near the chest reads clearly at the fitted extent. The short whole-body carry keeps the baby attached to the authored palms.

source_items.name: First lower
source_items.review: Forward palms and connected elbows communicate lowering. The preceding hold-to-lower boundary still has a 28.32px vertical palm jump.

source_items.name: Lower
source_items.review: The next downward pose retains costume and tail identity. Its similarity to the preceding key requires temporal review rather than assuming motion quality.

source_items.name: Reach down
source_items.review: Downward attention and a longer connected reach prepare placement. Native pixels remain complete through the packing window.

source_items.name: Set down
source_items.review: Low palms approach painted cushion support. This held final state is visible before feeding; empty return still needs acting review.
